title: Admissibility-aware physical tangent acquisition at real-SWAP corrector boundaries
question: Can the physical q_swap(H) tangent be estimated transaction-safely at one-sided real-SWAP admissibility boundaries, without hard-coding the admissible direction, and does that remove the G08 TANGENT_UNAVAILABLE failure mode?

E0_CENTRAL.rule: Use (q(h+d)-q(h-d))/(2d) only when both probes are status 0; otherwise halve d. No one-sided fallback.

rule: Current h must itself be status 0.
Probe h-d and h+d from the same immutable accepted origin.
If both probes are status 0, use the central secant.
If exactly one first probe is status 0, infer the admissible direction only from those statuses; probe a second point at 2d in that same direction.
If the second one-sided point is status 0, use the fixed three-point second-order one-sided derivative formula.
If neither side, or the required second point, is admissible, halve d and retry.
Require a finite negative slope; otherwise classify TANGENT_UNAVAILABLE.

estimator_consistency.method: Recompute E1 from half the selected d where possible, with the same status-driven rule.

targeted_policy_replay.reason: This exact preregistered G08 boundary start produced all six TANGENT_UNAVAILABLE policy runs.
targeted_policy_replay.groundwater_regimes: Reuse the three frozen G08 groundwater regimes without changing K, storage, head bias or probe sets.
policies: P1-E1: raw physical Newton using E1 at every iterate.
P4-E1: same E1 tangent plus the existing factor-1/2 admissibility and residual-nonincrease safeguard.

qualification_rules: All estimator probes and policy diagnostics are trial->evaluate->discard and leave revision/time/ledger unchanged.
E0 failure and E1 success at C2 negative edge is required to close the specific G08 tangent-acquisition gap.
Every E1 boundary estimate must satisfy the frozen 5% half-step consistency gate.
Where E0 is available, E1 must agree with E0 within 5%.
The C2 negative policy replay must no longer classify TANGENT_UNAVAILABLE under E1.
P4 safeguard exercise is recorded but not required for G09 success; G09 is an estimator work unit.
No production HCOF/RHS or production coupling source is changed.
